private theorem actual_app_marker_function_subtrace
    [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (classes : EqualityNormalize.Constraints)
    (onlyMarker : classes = [[[1], [2, 0, 0]]])
    (resultType marker function argument : Value Symbol Guard)
    (results : List (Value Symbol Guard)) (before after : State Symbol Guard)
    (memos saved : EndpointMemoGateTrace.Memos)
    (reads : SourceCurrentRequiredQueryMemos.RequireAllReads
      (SourceEqualitySelectedRequired.paths classes)
      [resultType, marker, function, argument] results before after memos saved) :
    ∃ functionResult,
      results = [resultType, marker, functionResult, argument] ∧
      ∃ actual : SourceEqualityRequiredGraph.RequireNode
          (SourceEqualityNeeded.build [[0, 0]]) function before functionResult after,
        SourceCurrentRequiredQueryMemos.NodeReads actual memos saved

--- Source.lean
+++ Source.lean
@@ -28 +28 @@

--- Source.lean
+++ Source.lean
@@ -26,3 +25,0 @@
-  have selectedPaths : SourceEqualitySelectedRequired.paths [[[1], [2, 0, 0]]] =
-      [[1], [2, 0, 0]] := by
-    simp [SourceEqualitySelectedRequired.paths, EqualityNormalize.canonicalClass, List.mergeSort]
@@ -32 +28,0 @@
-    rw [selectedPaths]
@@ -35,23 +31,39 @@
-  obtain ⟨_trace, memoReads⟩ := reads
-  cases memoReads with
-  | unselected after0 =>
-      cases after0 with
-      | unselected _rest => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-      | selected markerReads after1 =>
-          cases markerReads with
-          | identity =>
-              cases after1 with
-              | unselected _rest => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-              | selected functionReads after2 =>
-                  cases after2 with
-                  | unselected after3 =>
-                      cases after3
-                      simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] <;>
-                        first
-                        | exact ⟨_, rfl, _, functionReads⟩
-                        | exact ⟨_, functionReads⟩
-                  | selected _first _rest => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-          | empty => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-          | ordinary => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-          | recursive => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
-  | selected _first _rest => simp_all [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup]
+  obtain ⟨trace, memoReads⟩ := reads
+  cases trace with
+  | unselected _zero _absent rest0 =>
+      cases memoReads with
+      | unselected after0 =>
+          cases rest0 with
+          | unselected _one absent _rest =>
+              simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at absent
+          | selected _one found first1 rest1 =>
+              simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at found
+              cases found
+              cases after0 with
+              | selected markerReads after1 =>
+                  cases first1 with
+                  | identity =>
+                      cases markerReads
+                      cases rest1 with
+                      | unselected _two absent _rest =>
+                          simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at absent
+                      | selected _two found first2 rest2 =>
+                          simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at found
+                          cases found
+                          cases after1 with
+                          | selected functionReads after2 =>
+                              cases rest2 with
+                              | unselected _three _absent rest3 =>
+                                  cases after2 with
+                                  | unselected after3 =>
+                                      cases rest3 with
+                                      | nil =>
+                                          cases after3
+                                          exact ⟨_, rfl, first2, functionReads⟩
+                              | selected _three found _first _rest =>
+                                  simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at found
+                  | empty nonempty => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
+                  | ordinary nonempty _rows _rebuilt => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
+                  | recursive nonempty _recursive _head _body => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
+  | selected _zero found _first _rest =>
+      simp [SourceEqualityNeededMap.lookup] at found
